_note: Engine tunables for the side-view platform fighter, from DESIGN.md where it gives numbers. Frames are 1/60 s; distances are stage pixels (480x270, y down). See BALANCE.md.

bow._note: Agurra: every round opens with a bow. A fighter who attacks before 'Hasi!' loses a slice of super meter (once per round).

stats._note: Speed 1-5 -> run speed px/frame; Power 1-5 -> damage x (0.8 + 0.1 x Power); weight -> knockback taken and fall speed; toughness: knockback x the square root of (100 / toughness).

elements._note: Ura beats Sua, Sua beats Basoa, Basoa beats Harria, Harria beats Ura. Gaua is neutral (stronger in darkness, Milestone 3).

cpu._note: The computer opponent (src/core/cpu.js). react: frames before it reacts to a move or a shot, and between decisions. dodge: chance it rolls away from a threat it has seen. aggression: chance it attacks when in reach. combo: chance it finishes a combo. special/super: chance it uses them when they'd work.

physics._note: Snappy movement in the manner of Super Smash Flash. Run speed comes from stats; `traction` is how fast you stop. Tap up for a short hop (`shortHop` x jump), hold up for a full hop; down in the air while falling is a fast fall. `jumpsquat` frames pass before leaving the ground: pressing A in them gives the up attack instead.

match._note: Super Smash Flash style: stocks (lives) and a time limit. After a ring-out a fighter comes back after `respawn` frames on a floating stone, invincible for `invincible` frames.

shield._note: Hold C on the ground. It shrinks while held and with every blow; at 0 it breaks and the fighter is dizzy.

grab._note: C + A (or A while shielding). Pummel with A; throw with a direction. The held fighter breaks free after `hold` + `holdPer` x damage% frames.

ledge._note: Hanging on the corner of the main platform. Up jumps off, toward the stage climbs, A climbs with an attack, C rolls on, down or away lets go.
